newsitem.title: USA: Envirodyne says holders rebuff Zapata.
newsitem.headline: Envirodyne says holders rebuff Zapata.

text.p: Envirodyne Industries Inc said preliminary results from Friday's annual meeting showed stockholders elected the five director nominees proposed by the company.
The results also showed that stockholders rejected a proposal submitted by Zapata Corp, its largest stockholder, to remove the company's stockholder rights plan.
The annual meeting was recessed pending receipt of final certification of the vote. Final results are expected within a week and will be publicly announced, Envirodyne said.
Shares in Envirodyne, a food packaging and food supplies company, were up 1/8 to 6-3/4. Shares in Zapata were unchanged at 4-1/8.
